review_scope: Official Analysis Plugin contracts, fixed LangGraph, A2A/MCP/provider boundaries, grounding and non-executable Artifact, private state, requester isolation, binding/revoke fence, OCI, supply chain, compatibility, fault, performance, formal soak and operational completion evidence

findings.title: The seventh independent deployable Analysis module did not exist
findings.resolution: Implemented the official masi.analysis.langgraph analysis-agent as an independent bounded Python 3.12 process and hardened OCI service with direct typed A2A, restricted MCP, provider, private-state and lifecycle boundaries.

findings.title: Initial Analysis contracts lacked complete A2A, MCP, provider, binding and shared golden surfaces
findings.resolution: Added strict versioned schemas, canonical bytes, negative validation and Go/Python shared goldens for frozen input, task, Artifact, provider and direct adapter boundaries.

findings.title: Any allowlisted A2A client could read another client task and trace by task ID
findings.resolution: The exact authenticated SAN is now attached to admission and durably owns the private task; submit replay, poll and trace all return indistinguishable not-found to any different trusted principal.

findings.title: SQLite owner, mode and persisted input or Artifact digests were not revalidated
findings.resolution: Production storage now requires a runtime-owned private directory, creates the database no-follow at mode 0600, rejects incompatible schema and recomputes frozen-input and Artifact canonical digests on every read.

findings.title: Outbound A2A accepted under-validated peer task identity and Artifact content
findings.resolution: The restricted peer profile now validates a strict task envelope and closed non-executable Artifact, checks exact peer plugin/binding/input/trace identity, keeps task/context stable through polling, validates content digests and recomputes every call deadline from the parent deadline.

findings.title: The first Python base and runtime payload failed current offline vulnerability policy
findings.resolution: Moved to a digest-pinned Python 3.12.13 Alpine 3.23 base, upgraded aiohttp, removed unrelated contracts from the runtime image, refreshed the offline scanner database and required repository@sha256 input in deployment assets; the scan is zero Critical, zero fixable High and zero secret.

findings.title: Standalone passing runners could not derive operational Module Complete
findings.resolution: Added immutable command sidecars, strict Analysis evidence schemas, exact source/status and artifact digests, findings and requirement traceability, semantic tamper negatives, real release and OCI evidence, formal 3600-second soak validation and a machine-derived completion summary that retains qualification-only HOLDs.

findings.title: The first formal OCI run observed a transient required-file mount miss
findings.resolution: The formal runner umask exposed root-owned 0700 mount directories even though their files were owned by UID 65532. The smoke now explicitly makes both mount directories 65532:65532 mode 0700, then independently starts a network-none, non-root, read-only preflight container to prove required files are readable and the runtime carries exactly three startup schemas before launching the business container.

findings.title: Formal soak collapsed distinct HTTP failures and restarted on file-only readiness
findings.resolution: The soak now records bounded phase, task, operation, HTTP status and exception diagnostics; counts the one deliberately killed in-flight request through an explicit crash-only path; verifies the authenticated /health/ready boundary after startup and restart; and still rejects every non-crash HTTP or unclassified error.

findings.title: Fresh vulnerability data rejected the prior Alpine runtime libraries
findings.resolution: Rebuilt the candidate as CPython 3.12.13 on a digest-pinned Wolfi runtime, selected ABI-matched OpenSSL 3.0.20 files by exact digest, added effective Python/OpenSSL/SQLite/zlib probes plus builder provenance evidence, and reran the actual hardened OCI business test and fresh offline supply gate with zero final Critical, zero final fixable High, zero selected-library Critical/fixable High, and zero secrets.
